description: TOWER T-02 async audit mirror of Postgres slots (ADR-02: never block a hold on BQ). One row per slot write; full Slot JSON in `slot`, filter/sort fields promoted to columns.

schema.name: slot
schema.description: Full Slot JSON {id, production, resource_type, resource_id, start, end, status, request_id, trace_id}

schema.name: trace_id
schema.description: Correlation id shared with Mimir / Loki / Tempo

schema.name: created_at
schema.description: Row write time; DAY partition field (UTC)
